search_log: Bausch + Lomb (CIK 0001860742) 8-K earnings Exhibit 99.1 (2023Q1-2026Q2) tables print only segment lines (Vision Care / Surgical / Pharmaceuticals); 10-Q/10-K 2023-2026 and the releases print no Miebo/Xiidra table row (prose mentions only, e.g. 'MIEBO sales of $112 million in the fourth quarter' in the 2026-02-18 release).

Quarterly product revenue is printed in the 'Top 10 Revenues' slide of the earnings presentations on ir.bausch.com (listing pages per year via field_event_year_target_id); decks 3Q23-2Q26 parsed with pdfplumber (scripts/bl.py, decks_bl.py). The 4Q23 and 3Q23 decks print no product figure; the 1Q25 and 4Q25 decks could not be located on the IR site (guessed paths returned 404), so quarters without own-deck figures use the trailing columns of a later deck (direct_retrospective_table).
Launch: B+L 10-Q for 2023Q3 states the U.S. launch occurred in September 2023; the first printed revenue is $1M for 3Q23 (3Q24 deck trailing column).
